propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion from the rebar repository through the full four-pass pipeline to validate end-to-end project-criterion execution in production.

A valid positive-control patchset that requires explicit phase/action/owner identification must produce zero project-attributed findings, demonstrating the criterion's operation on compliant instructions.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset containing a cross-phase directive must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries], with observed validity and impact attributes in Pass-2.

The final submitted patchset must contain only phase-compliant instructions, produce no project-criterion finding, and remain in the repository on main with blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 unchanged.

Historical severity-only directive abstention and predeclared corpus FIRE control execution must both be recorded unchanged as evidence of stimulus limits and criterion capability without tuning or improvisation.

Blocking promotion is deferred to a separate future ticket backed by representative production data; this story observes only and does not enable blocking or change the rubric in response to probe results.
